trap.label: who/that/which
trap.wrong: The woman who she works here is my aunt.
trap.right: The woman who works here is my aunt.
trap.why: O aluno repete o sujeito (que ela trabalha) por interferência de 'que ela', como em português coloquial; em inglês who já é o sujeito.

mcq.q: The man ___ lives next door is kind.
The book ___ is on the table is mine.
A pen is a thing ___ you write with.
Qual está certa? (Relative clauses (who, that, which): introduction)
opts: A teacher is a person teaches.
A teacher is a person who he teaches.
A teacher is a person who teaches.

fix.wrong: The girl who she sings is Ana.
fix.right: The girl who sings is Ana.

fix.wrong: The book who I read is great.
fix.right: The book that I read is great.

fix.wrong: A doctor is a person which helps.
fix.right: A doctor is a person who helps.

rewrite.prompt: Junte com who: “I know a man. He plays piano.”
rewrite.answer: I know a man who plays piano.

rewrite.prompt: Junte com that: “This is the book. I love it.”
rewrite.answer: This is the book that I love.

rewrite.prompt: Junte com which: “She has a car. It is red.”
rewrite.answer: She has a car which is red.
